_note: Landing subsystem (GER) local numbers, owner D5. Read by fusion/landing.py (ctx.local) and team/D5/feet_calc.py (P:landing.*). Shared numbers (fin TE x, fin half-height, foot height, CG, loads) come from params/params.json and are not repeated here. Frame: params.json#frame (x aft, y right, z up, metres). Each foot is a telescoping crush unit: a bonded PETG shoe (sleeve) on the fin TE tip, a PETG piston with a flange and a rubber pad, and an XPS crush cartridge between the piston floor and the shoe back wall. Stack along +x, from the fin TE tip to the ground: shoe back wall, cartridge, piston floor/flange, pad; the flange hits the sleeve end after stroke_max_m.

section_y_m.note: crush area 11 x 18 = 198 mm2 sets the plateau force; the tuning knob after the coupon test T-D5-COUPON

segments.note: two 38.5 mm pieces cut across a 2 in F-250 board so the crush axis is the board's through-thickness axis (the datasheet direction)

clear_m.note: per side, cartridge in the piston bore

preload_m.note: cartridge cut 0.5 mm long so the snap hooks seat against the window edge without play

wall_t_m.note: two 0.4 mm perimeters, 100 % solid; shoe sleeve and piston skirt

slide_clear_m.note: per side, piston in sleeve (PETG on PETG); check with the first print

leg_depth_m.note: U-channel legs bonded to both fin faces

glue_gap_m.note: per side between leg and fin face (epoxy line)

window_z_m.note: snap-hook window height in the two y walls

flange_t_m.note: floor and stop flange; bending of the outboard overhang under the ultimate foot load

engage_m.note: skirt engagement in the sleeve before any crush; grows to engage + stroke

hook_protrusion_m.note: snap hook into the 0.8 mm window

replace_mark_m.note: groove on the skirt 6 mm aft of the sleeve end: once it is inside the sleeve, less than the design stroke is left; replace the cartridge

z_outer_m.note: CR-A1-20 splay: outboard edge of the pad and flange; tip-over pivot = z_outer - edge_r

edge_r_m.note: edge round on the flange and pad

stroke_max_m.note: flange-to-sleeve-end gap; the wing TE stays >= 13 mm off the ground at full stroke

glue_g_per_foot.note: epoxy bead on the shoe (0.30) + foam-safe CA on the cartridge (0.05)
